upcoming_earnings.ai_summary_en: TSM is scheduled to report earnings on 2026-10-15 with consensus EPS of 4.46 and revenue of 45.7B. The company holds a historical beat rate of 1.0. Focus centers on whether growth momentum sustains against elevated expectations in the foundry segment.

upcoming_earnings.action_note_en: Monitor positioning and review options flow ahead of 2026-10-15 release.
